card.name: Inside hydrate and chemical names
card.fires_on: The odd spelled-out piece right before 'hydrate' (mon-oh-ydrate, hex-ah-ydrate, di-h-ydrate) or inside long chemical names like tetraacetic acid and diphosphate.

modes.label: Hydrate prefixes
modes.description: The piece just before 'ydrate' in salt hydrate names such as monohydrate or hexahydrate.

modes.label: Long chemical names
modes.description: A middle piece inside a long systematic chemical name.

card.plain: It marks the middle of chemical names, mostly hydrate salts like monohydrate and hexahydrate.
